messages:
rachael: Heads-up: next all-hands is Thursday 9:30am PT. We're calling it the 'Launch Review + Ops Pulse'. Rough plan: 8m exec update, 12m launch metrics & incident recap, 10m product wins/customers, 8m infra & reliability, 7m lightning demos (2x 3.5m), 5m live Q&A. Please read the short pre-brief before joining.

omar: Saved the invite and added rooms for overflow (video + dial-in). Link: <https://calendar.redwood.com/event/launch-pulse-1747654321>.

jyoti: Request: can we get the slides into the shared folder by Wed 4pm so we can pre-record a few clips? Shared deck: <https://drive.redwood.com/rdw/launch_review>.

ben_ops: Quick ops note 10: we had a regional routing flake Sat that impacted ~3% of hosts for ~12m; well include a one-paragraph RCA during the incident recap. Follow-up postmortem will be posted to #incidents and linked in the resources doc.

rachael: Accessibility: captions ON, transcript will be attached. If you need language interpretation or ASL, DM tess.

tess: Can people indicate in-thread if they need interpretation so we can schedule interpreters? Reply: "interpretation: yes".

omar: For presenters: please include one slide called "impact & ask" (what we want teams to do next). Also ensure demos have network recording turned on before presenting. Ping me if you need access.

jyoti: LIVE question : will we share the post-launch performance dashboard publicly?

rachael: LIVE answer : yes we'll publish a read-only dashboard link after the meeting and attach the snapshot to the follow-up notes.

ben_ops: Action items: 1) Presenters upload slides by Wed 4pm (owners: product, eng, support). 2) Ops to publish the incident one-pager by Wed EOD. 3) Tess to collect interpretation needs by Tue midday. 4) Rachael to post final agenda Mon morning.

allhands-bot: Reminder: recording will start automatically; transcript posted to #all-hands-resources after the meeting. Reminders scheduled: 48h, 2h, and 15m before start. :calendar:

rachael: Thanks everyone. If you have a short customer highlight or demo to propose, drop a 1-line blurb here. We'll pick two for lightning demos.
